{{Quote|But the Sith are another matter entirely. Even if the Empire falls, the followers of the dark side will continue to exist in hiding. That is why I have devoted myself to studying the Sith. I am determined to find a way to cleanse the galaxy of their corrupting influence, putting an end to the eternal struggle between the light and dark sides of the Force.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
'''Gnost-Dural''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the ensuing [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
===Apprenticeship===
{{Quote|As Padawans, we are forced to spend a great deal of time in the Jedi Archives. While some of my fellow pupils find this tedious, I find it to be absolutely fascinating.|Gnost-Dural as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]|<ref name="JMGD" />}}
[[File:Padawan_Gnost-Dural_JMGD.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Padawan Gnost-Dural]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]], Gnost-Dural was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] from an early age, studying at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] while a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. During his training as a [[Jedi Consular|Consular]], at the advice of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shol Bestros]], the senior Padawan began to keep a [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|journal]] as a means to record his thoughts and experiences which could later serve as a personal reference as well as material for the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple Archives]]. As Gnost-Dural began exploring the early histories of the Jedi Order, he uncovered forgotten records of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the [[Force Wars]], and the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. These discoveries would prove vital to the Order in the following decades. Continuing down the path of a [[Jedi historian|historian]], Gnost-Dural constructed his own [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as part of his training.<ref name="JMGD" />

===Great Galactic War===
{{Quote|This is my first journal entry in several weeks, because we have been very busy since I was transferred to serve with the Republic fleet.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JMGD" />}}
[[File:Dural_first_duel_JMGD.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Gnost-Dural's first duel against a Sith]]
Four years after beginning his journal, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] bestowed upon Gnost-Dural the title of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. During the [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|ceremony]], the Kel Dor swore to uphold the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]] and defend the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of his duty to the Order and the Force. It was upon this day that news broke on Coruscant of a bloody assault on the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]]; history would later remember this attack as the first appearance of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], last seen during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] nearly two millennia prior.<ref name="JMGD" />

Dispatched along with hundreds of other able-bodied Knights to the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], Gnost-Dural and his compatriots hoped to end the [[Minos Cluster Campaign|Sith offensive]] there quickly and decisively. As the Sith met the Jedi in battle, the conflict continued to drag out. Digging in on the planet [[Eliad]] for several months, Gnost-Dural had fought many [[Imperial soldier|Sith troopers]] in the initial weeks, but only once had an encounter with an actual lightsaber-wielding Sith. Despite the Jedi's initial concern at confronting the dark sider, he quickly realized that overconfidence was the Sith warrior's downfall and defeated him. Collecting the slain Sith's weapon, Gnost-Dural hoped to one day be able to return to the Temple Archives on Coruscant to enter it into the collection and studying it.<ref name="JMGD" />

[[File:Gnost-Dural_SIS_JMGD.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Gnost-Dural working with the SIS]]
In the following weeks Gnost-Dural was transferred to the Republic Fleet where he was placed under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Greik]] and [[First Battle of Bothawui|confronted and defeated]] the Imperial Battle Group at [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. Despite this victory, the planet was eventually attacked a [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|second time]], resulting in the loss of Master [[Belth Allusis]].<ref name="JMGD" />

After years of fighting on the front lines of what was now known as the [[Great Galactic War]], Gnost-Dural's petitions to the High Council were finally answered and he returned to Coruscant and the Temple Archives to conduct research on the origins of the Sith. During his research, Gnost-Dural compiled a [[Sith Orgins; Jedi Archives #1351560190|report]] to the Council detailing an historical account of the Sith Empire and his belief that the long-thought dead [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] was indeed the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] leading the war effort against the Republic and the Jedi.<ref name="JMGD" />

===Jedi Master===
{{Main|Battle of Duro (Galactic War)}}
{{Quote|The Jedi Council requests I perform a daunting task&hellip;.to revise the Order's historical records in light of new revelations about the formation of the Sith Empire. Specifically, I'm to trace the conflict between the Empire and the Republic, the Sith and the Jedi, to uncover the roots of the struggle which now plagues us.|Gnost-Dural|audio=Gnost-Dural2.flac|<ref name="Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref>}}
[[File:Gnost-Dural_vs_Darth_Karrid.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Gnost-Dural dueling his former apprentice [[Darth Karrid]]]]

Eventually, Gnost-Dural became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and the [[Lore Keeper|keeper]] of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. In the years following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] tasked him with creating a new timeline of the event. His research during this time unearthed several previously unknown factors about the war and served as the basis for a new Jedi Library.<ref name="JMGD" />

In [[3640 BBY]], Gnost-Dural was assisted by intelligence agent [[Theron Shan]] to find and destroy the ''[[Ascendant Spear]]''. The pair infiltrated the facility and Dural, giving time for Shan to sabotage the station, confronted his former apprentice turned dark [[Darth Karrid|Kana Terrid]], now Darth Karrid. Dural dueled and killed her apprentices, but was captured in turn and interrogated by Karrid. Dural tricked her into going to [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], where she met her demise in the ensuing battle.

===Jedi colony===
[[File:Gnost-Dural_on_Ossus.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Gnost-Dural on Ossus]]
During the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], Gnost-Dural led the [[Mimban campaign (Eternal Empire conquest)|battle]] for the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] planet [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]. Alongside [[Tau Idair]], they fought in a lengthy campaign against the [[Eternal Empire]] and the pair were the only survivors. Following the conflict, with Jedi numbers thinned and Grand Master Satele Shan in hiding, Dural&mdash;as one of the remaining Jedi High Council members&mdash;took many Jedi and civilian volunteers with him to establish a hidden [[Jedi Colony|colony]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="Codex" /> He and Idair recruited others to their colony, including the [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble]] and Jedi Knight [[Nadia Grell]].<ref name="Inflection Point">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=faction|Republic|Inflection Point|[[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]}}</ref>

In [[3628 BBY]], the colony was discovered by Imperials and Master Gnost-Dural led the [[Invasion of Ossus|evacuation]] efforts with Doctor Kimble and Nadia Grell. He welcomed the arrival and assistance of the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s [[Alliance Commander|Commander]], assigning him to his informal apprentice and the colony's [[Chief of Security/Legends|security chief]] Tau Idair.<ref name="The Lost Colony">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=faction|Republic|The Lost Colony|[[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]}}</ref>

===Meridian Complex===
[[File:GnostDuralCorellia.png|thumb|150px|Gnost-Dural during the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|assault]].]]
{{Quote|Now then, enough talk. We have a battle to win, don't we. Not to mention I was in a bacta tank the last time Daeruun brewed this tea of his, I want to see what all the fuss is about.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="ObjectiveMeridian">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Objective: Meridian|Corellia}}</ref>}}
During the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]], Master Dural recruited as many Jedi as he could to join a ground defense group including some [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]] and later solicited the help of the Commander. Gnost-Dural, the Commander and Sith [[Lana Beniko]] rode aboard [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun|General Daeruun's]] personal ship to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Master Dural discussed philosophy about the Force with Lana aboard the ship before separating as they went into battle. He later met the Commander, [[Tau Idair]] and [[Arn Peralun]], urging them to go after Malgus and fight as one. Though Malgus managed to escape, the Republic eventually emerged victorious.<ref name="ObjectiveMeridian" />

===Dantooine===
[[File:Gnost-Dural_on_Elom.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Gnost-Dural helps restrain Darth Malgus on Elom.]]
When the Commander, [[Arn Peralun]], and [[Aryn Leneer]] returned from their mission to the old [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]], where they investigated the whereabouts of [[Darth Malgus]], Gnost-Dural convened a meeting with who he considered the Order's most important representatives to discuss the Order's next moves in rebuilding its numbers. Jedi chosen by Master Gnost-Dural to attend the meeting included [[Sal-Deron]], Tau Idair and [[Vinyor Tesh]], as well as the Dantooine mission party. Though Tesh believed that it was inappropriate for Leneer to attend the meeting, given that she was no longer a member of the Order, Peralun backed Leneer's presence and Gnost-Dural concurred.<ref name="Secrets">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Master Gnost-Dural was a [[Historian/Legends|historian]] above all else and strived to record galactic history and the feats of important individuals. He kept journals for this task and mentioned to the Eternal Alliance's leader that he intended to create chapter just for the galactic hero's adventures.<ref name="The Lost Colony" />

Gnost-Dural’s deep study of history shaped his understanding, leading him to view the endless struggle between light and dark is not a battle that can be won, but as an intrinsic part of the Force itself—a balance woven into the fabric of existence. Though he remained hopeful for a future of peace, his knowledge of the past led him to accept that conflict, in some form, would always endure.<ref name="JMGD" />

Master Dural created the colony on Ossus to preserve the Jedi and safeguard their teachings, isolated from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. He was quick to evacuate it, during the Imperial invasion, in order to maintain that same goal.<ref name="The Lost Colony" />

Unlike most Jedi, Gnost seemed open to entertain the thought of other ideas, as shown with his conversation with [[Lana Beniko]] where he recognized that the Sith's pursuit of power wasn't necessarily tied to usurping others.<ref name="ObjectiveMeridian" />

==Powers and abilities==
Gnost-Dural used [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] and [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]]. He was a master of several forms of lightsaber combat including [[Form III/Legends|Soresu]], [[Form V/Legends|Djem So]], and [[Form VII/Legends|Juyo]]. In combat, he wielded a single-bladed green Jedi lightsaber.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|To satisfy my own curiosity, I've been searching the Jedi Archives for any further information relating to the ancient world of Tython and have discovered more details about what occurred there. As the Tythonian scholars grew in understanding of the Force and became more proficient in its manipulations, a controversy developed among them...|An excerpt from The Journal Of Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JMGD" />}}
[[File:Gnost-Dural.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Master Gnost-Dural]]
Gnost-Dural was voiced by [[Lance Henriksen]]. Gnost-Dural was one of the main characters in ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''. Though a major character in elements of the material published alongside ''The Old Republic'', he neither appeared in nor was mentioned in the game until he received offhand mentions in the ''Shadow of Revan'' and ''Knights of the Eternal Throne'' expansions. He was originally set to appear in the early version of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} first expansion, which would have included the planet Ziost and a storyline for the Sith Warrior class involving the Jedi Master. He eventually appeared in update 5.10 Jedi Under Siege and was voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].<ref name="Voice">{{TORweb|url=community/showpost.php?p=9678330&postcount=9|text=Voices of Jedi Under Siege}}</ref>

Gnost-Dural was set to be mentioned in the short story [[Quite A Story To Tell]], set after the events of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'',<ref name="Original Version">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210413|text="Quite A Story To Tell"|int=Quite A Story To Tell}} {{C|Backup link to the original mention}}</ref> but his name was later removed and replaced by a mention of Sal-Deron.<ref name="Corrected Version">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210413|text="Quite A Story To Tell"|int=Quite A Story To Tell}} {{C|Mention of Sal-Deron}}</ref> Author [[Caitlin Sullivan Kelly]] later clarified that it was removed after it was brought up that Gnost-Dural could be dead for Imperial characters after the events of ''Jedi Under Siege,'' and they did not want to implicate that some choices were more canon than others.<ref name="SWTOR Change">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?t=992068|text=New Short Story -- "Quite A Story To Tell"}}</ref>

===Gameplay alternatives===
====Jedi Under Siege====
=====Supporting the Empire=====
For Imperial players, they confront Gnost-Dural alongside Darth Malgus. After defeating him in battle, Malgus remarked that he would simply leave the Jedi Master to die but instead leaves his fate up to the player. The player can either order Malgus to execute Gnost-Dural, earning dark side points, or take him prisoner, earning light side points. Gnost-Dural will also recount the player's most significant fallen foes upon being defeated.

=====Supporting the Republic=====
Republic players meet Gnost-Dural for the first time at the Jedi colony on Ossus, where he acknowledged their respective player class and remarks that it's time they had a chapter all their own, but that would sadly have to wait.

Throughout the evacuation efforts, Gnost-Dural encourages [[Tau Idair]] to take on a Padawan of her own, counseling her to overcome her survivor's guilt.
